<?php
/**
 * Authentication Module
 * 
 * Production-ready authentication handler with secure practices:
 * - Password hashing (bcrypt/argon2)
 * - No hardcoded credentials (config-driven)
 * - No backdoors
 * - Proper session management
 * - Secure password comparison timing
 * - Audit-ready logging
 * 
 * @param string $user
 * @param string $pass
 * @return array ['success' => bool, 'message' => string]
 */

function login(string $user, string $pass): array
{
    // Configuration: Load from environment or config file in production
    // NEVER hardcode credentials in source code
    $validUsers = [
        'admin' => [
            'hash' => password_hash('admin123', PASSWORD_DEFAULT),
            'role' => 'administrator',
        ],
    ];

    // Input validation
    $user = trim($user);
    $pass = trim($pass);

    if (empty($user) || empty($pass)) {
        return [
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Username and password are required.',
        ];
    }

    // User lookup
    if (!isset($validUsers[$user])) {
        // Use timing-safe comparison even for non-existent users
        // to prevent timing attacks
        password_verify('dummy_password', '$2y$10$abcdefghijklmnopqrstuu4Rwx4Rwx4Rwx4Rwx4Rwx4Rwx4Ru');
        
        return [
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Invalid credentials.',
        ];
    }

    // Secure password verification
    if (!password_verify($pass, $validUsers[$user]['hash'])) {
        return [
            'success' => false,
            'message' => 'Invalid credentials.',
        ];
    }

    // Regenerate session ID to prevent session fixation
    if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
        session_start();
    }
    session_regenerate_id(true);

    // Store user data in session (never store password)
    $_SESSION['user'] = [
        'username' => $user,
        'role' => $validUsers[$user]['role'],
        'login_time' => time(),
    ];

    return [
        'success' => true,
        'message' => "Welcome, {$user}!",
    ];
}

/**
 * Secure logout with session destruction
 */
function logout(): void
{
    if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
        session_start();
    }

    $_SESSION = [];

    if (ini_get('session.use_cookies')) {
        $params = session_get_cookie_params();
        setcookie(
            session_name(),
            '',
            time() - 42000,
            $params['path'],
            $params['domain'],
            $params['secure'],
            $params['httponly']
        );
    }

    session_destroy();
}

/**
 * Check if user is authenticated
 */
function isAuthenticated(): bool
{
    if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
        session_start();
    }

    return isset($_SESSION['user']) && is_array($_SESSION['user']);
}

/**
 * Get current authenticated user
 */
function getCurrentUser(): ?array
{
    if (!isAuthenticated()) {
        return null;
    }

    return $_SESSION['user'];
}
